line: This agent can send emails by itself. It never does.
Because once it's sent, you can't take it back — even if it's wrong.
One wrong tone, one wrong fact, and it's already out.
So it only ever writes a draft. You read it, you click send.
One switch in the workflow: create draft, never send.
Every agent that touches your inbox should stop right there.
Build the draft, never the send. You click every time.
The exact setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for setups that actually works.
